Haha this is awesome. Elon agreed to the "greenshoe" IPO option but only if the bankers and team all wore actual green shoes 😂🔥

I love the incredible people of SpaceX beyond words

A man working as a welder at SpaceX for $28 an hour has just become a millionaire.

Juan Hernandez, who came from Mexico, welded rockets for SpaceX at $28 an hour. 

SpaceX gave him $10,000 in stock when he went full time in 2015, and he bought more with every paycheck for 10 years.

$SPCX is now trading at $167, making his shares worth over $1 million.

ANTONIO GRACIAS on @SpaceX:  “We have 20,000 people here. They're some of the best engineers in the world. 

“And what we're building is the entire stack from, energy to compute, to launch to orbital compute. 

“What an investor is buying today, we've been buying for really 20 years — is the ability to help make the future is being part of this extraordinary company.”
